title: ZigZag high/low break confirmation + ICT candle-zone pullback + engulfing entry, multigroup grid-martingale
entry_long: price breaks above prior ZigZag high (arm mode B=1) then pulls back forming 3 consecutive bearish candles whose range = ICT zone; price re-enters zone (above zone-low, below zone-high) and bullish engulfing forms on ID1 -> open first buy
entry_short: mirror: break below prior ZigZag low (arm mode S=1), 3 consecutive bullish candles form ICT zone, price re-enters zone, bearish engulfing -> open first sell
exit: no SL/TP on entries; FL-train (trend-follow) mode adds same-direction lot at every 100 pips profit then manages with trailing stop = base(150)*2*ATR-multiplier (dynamic, turn-on-box used twice to force trigger reliably); Reverse-train (martingale correction) mode adds against-position lot every 100 pips loss, +0.01 lot every 5 corrective orders (C_end_pass counter), capped max 50 orders/group; group closes at profit = close_money(5) + orders/5 * 5 USD; hanging-order cleanup via 30s delayed position-count check
escalation_cap: max 50 orders/group; Volume Upper Limit 0.1 lot on all buy_now/sell_now
buildon_idea: already capped at 50 orders + 0.1 lot upper limit; build-on: replace market breakout entries with pending buy/sell limit orders placed at the ICT zone edge (maker fill, avoids paying spread on breakout chase); try linear vs log lot law for the reverse-train correction instead of flat +0.01 steps
novelty_note: combines ZigZag structure break with ICT-style candlestick supply/demand zone pullback confirmation plus engulfing trigger; more elaborate filter stack than plain EMA-cross, medium novelty

title: HyperTrend: EMA3/8/200 alignment + RSI(7) multi-level (70/75/80 or 30/25/20) entry with 5-candle high/low custom SL
timeframe: 1H (narrator states 1H performs best; usable on other TFs)
entry_long: EMA3>EMA200 and EMA3>EMA8 (uptrend alignment) and RSI(7) crosses above 70 or 75 or 80 (any one) -> open buy
entry_short: mirror downtrend alignment (EMA3<EMA200<... EMA3<EMA8) and RSI(7) crosses below 30 or 25 or 20 -> open sell
exit: SL = lowest/highest price of prior 5 candles pulled via Market Property (custom P-level), no TP; lot escalates in steps every 5 orders opened (exact multiplier not stated in transcript, described as 'increase lot size'); lot upper_limit capped at 1.0 lot; variables reset when position count = 0
escalation_cap: lot capped via Volume Upper Limit = 1.0 lot; step-count trigger = every 5 orders
buildon_idea: capped at 1.0 lot already; build-on by widening to more symbol/TF pairs since narrator confirms 1H is best window; also test replacing the stepped lot escalation with a fixed linear-add law for more predictable risk sizing
novelty_note: 3-EMA trend filter + 3-tier RSI breakout-momentum threshold entry with market-derived dynamic SL; common trend-following recipe, moderate novelty

title: RSI overbought/oversold momentum-continuation scouting EA with flash-move time-bomb cut-loss (no fixed SL)
entry_long: price above EMA200 and RSI(14) crosses above 70 or 75 or 80 (overbought momentum continuation, not reversal) -> open buy; protected by Time-Bomb-Down block: cut-loss immediately if price drops 100 pips within 5 seconds
entry_short: price below EMA200 and RSI(14) crosses below 30 or 25 or 20 -> open sell; protected by Time-Bomb-Up block: cut-loss if price rises 100 pips within 5 seconds
exit: no SL/TP fields set (protection is the time-bomb flash-move cut-loss instead); group closes at profit > 5 USD (close_money); lot doubles (L*2) every 5 orders opened
escalation_cap: none stated (no Volume Upper Limit / max-order block observed in this transcript, unlike sibling EAs)
buildon_idea: add an explicit Volume Upper Limit lot cap and a max-order cap (as used in the sibling EX143 EAs) before relying only on the time-bomb flash-cut; consider adding a real SL alongside the time-bomb trigger for a capped build-on variant; described by narrator as a 'scouting' EA (order-count over profit), good candidate for a signal/frequency study rather than direct deploy
novelty_note: counter-intuitive momentum-into-overbought entry (buys strength instead of fading it) combined with a time-based flash-move cut-loss instead of a fixed-distance SL; unusual mechanism, higher novelty

title: EX143 revise2: EMA3/8 trend + 60-pip distance filter entry, FL-train grid-add profit-riding + Reverse-train grid-martingale correction, ATR-dynamic trailing stop
symbol: EURUSD (tested Time Frame 15min in this video)
entry_long: EMA_fast(3)>EMA_slow(8) (uptrend) and price within 60 pips of EMA_fast (not chasing an extended move) -> open first buy in group1
entry_short: mirror: EMA_fast<EMA_slow (downtrend) and price within 60 pips of EMA_fast -> open first sell in group2
exit: FL-train (profit-riding) mode: add same-direction lot every 60 pips profit (fixed 0.01), managed by trailing stop = 15 pips * ATR-multiplier once group has >=2 orders (turn-on-box used to force-trigger reliably); Reverse-train (correction) mode: add against-position lot every 60 pips loss, +0.01 lot every 5 corrective orders (C_end_pass), capped at 50 orders/group; group closes at profit = close_money(5) + orders/order_step(5) * 5 USD; hanging-order cleanup via 30s delayed position-count recheck
escalation_cap: max 50 orders/group; Volume Upper Limit 0.1 lot on all buy_now/sell_now
buildon_idea: already capped at 50 orders + 0.1 lot; build-on: swap market entries for pending limit orders at the 60-pip EMA-distance edge; the 60-pip spacing is EURUSD-tuned, extend across more symbol/TF pairs with spacing rescaled to each instrument's volatility
novelty_note: standard EMA-cross grid EA; the notable technique is the ATR-scaled dynamic trailing stop plus a turn-on-box redundancy trick to fix a trailing-stop non-trigger bug reported by students; low-medium novelty, engineering refinement is the value

title: EX143 revise1: bugfix patch adding lot-jump cap, trailing-stop reliability nudge, and ATR-dynamic SL to the base EMA-trend grid-martingale EA
indicators: EMA (fast/slow, values unspecified in this patch video)
entry_long: unchanged from base EX143 (EMA fast>slow trend + distance filter) -- this video only patches bugs, does not redefine entry logic
entry_short: unchanged from base EX143 -- mirror of entry_long
exit: same as base EA but patched: (1) added Volume Upper Limit = 0.1 lot to buy_now/sell_now to stop abnormal lot jumps on some brokers, (2) added a turn_on_box call to re-trigger the trailing-stop block in case it fails to fire the first time, (3) added ATR*2-scaled dynamic trailing-stop distance (base 60 pips * ATR factor) replacing the fixed 60-pip trailing stop
escalation_cap: Volume Upper Limit 0.1 lot (newly added in this patch); underlying max-order cap same as base EA
buildon_idea: this is a bugfix video for EX143 -- treat as a patch, not a new EA; the fixes (volume cap, ATR-dynamic SL, redundant trigger) are directly reusable hardening techniques to apply to any of the sibling EMA-grid EAs in this family before deploy
novelty_note: not a new mechanism -- documents real production bugs (lot jump, trailing-stop non-trigger, order-close race causing hanging orders) and their fixes; useful as an engineering checklist rather than a strategy idea

title: EX143 original: EMA5/20 trend + 15-pip distance filter multi-group scouting EA, fixed 10-pip grid-add correction, optional Save-Mode flash-cut + order cap
symbol: EURUSD (10-pip grid tuned for EURUSD; narrator notes widen for XAUUSD)
entry_long: EMA_fast(5)>EMA_slow(20) (uptrend) and price within 15 pips of EMA_fast -> open first buy in group1 (only if buy-mode enabled by user)
entry_short: mirror: EMA_fast(5)<EMA_slow(20) and price within 15 pips of EMA_fast -> open first sell in group2 (only if sell-mode enabled)
exit: no SL/TP; FL-train mode trails profit with trailing stop 15 pips/step1; Reverse-train correction mode adds against-position lot every 10 pips loss, +0.01 lot every 5 corrective orders; group closes at profit > 5 USD (close_money); optional Save-Mode (off by default) caps at 15 orders/group and force-cuts loss if price moves 10 pips within 10 seconds against the position
escalation_cap: Volume Upper Limit 0.1 lot always on; 15-order cap and flash-cut only active if user enables Save-Mode (default OFF)
buildon_idea: default config ships with the order-count safety net (Save-Mode) turned off -- build-on should force it on; narrator reports 5yr (2019-2024) survival and 141%/9mo with DD ~22-24%, a promising build-on candidate once Save-Mode is enabled and tested with pending-limit entries instead of market entries
novelty_note: base version of the EX143 family (EMA-cross grid-martingale scouting EA); the Save-Mode optional kill-switch design is a reusable pattern worth cataloging

title: Smart Structure H1: ZigZag H1 structure break + ICT zone + engulfing entry (traded on M1) with distance-doubling grid-martingale correction
symbol: unspecified (gold implied by narrator's earlier videos, not explicit here)
timeframe: signal on H1 ZigZag structure, executed/checked on M1
entry_long: price breaks above prior H1 ZigZag high (mode buy=1) then pulls back into an ICT zone (3 consecutive bearish candles, zone size >100 pips) and the candle before entry is bullish -> open first buy, sized 0.01
entry_short: mirror: break below prior H1 ZigZag low (mode sell=1), pullback into ICT zone from 3 consecutive bullish candles (>100 pips), preceding candle bearish -> open first sell
exit: no SL/TP; corrective (against-position) re-entry uses a doubling grid distance per step (adjust_distance=2): 100 pips -> 200 -> 400 -> 800 pips etc, with lot +0.01 per corrective order; group closes at profit > 5 USD (close_money) OR hard stop-out at -3000 USD account loss (Cut Loss Money); lot capped via Volume Upper Limit 0.1
escalation_cap: grid distance itself doubles each corrective step (self-limiting order frequency); Volume Upper Limit 0.1 lot; hard account-level cut-loss at -3000 USD acts as a portfolio-level cap
buildon_idea: same base idea as EX140 (ZigZag break + ICT zone + engulfing) but adds a doubling-distance corrective grid instead of fixed-distance, which naturally slows re-entry frequency as drawdown grows -- worth comparing directly against EX140's fixed-distance grid for the same symbol/TF to see which correction law performs better; also test replacing the -3000 USD hard stop with a percentage-of-equity cap for portability across account sizes
novelty_note: reuses the EX140 ZigZag+ICT-zone+engulfing signal but on H1 structure traded down on M1, plus the doubling-distance grid law is the differentiator; medium novelty, mechanism variant of EX140
